content.short: Veramo provides performant, modular APIs for verifiable data and SSI.
content.description: Veramo is a JavaScript framework and a decentralized identity tool that enables applications to leverage cryptographically verifiable data. For dApps that rely on decentralized identifiers (DIDs) and verifiable credentials, the Veramo DID Agent delivers a plugin-based architecture. This design supports scalable, interoperable interactions across standards, helping developers implement verifiable data workflows and maintain cross-ecosystem compatibility without sacrificing security or flexibility.
content.meta: Veramo is a JavaScript framework for identity enabling cryptographically verifiable data. Discover Veramo and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
